en: A black-and-white historic postcard depicting a large town square bordered by multiple tall, gabled-roof buildings. Central to the image is a large fountain with a statue of a man (standing, wearing historical garments), accompanied by four lions, located in the square. Pedestrians and a horse can be seen in the square. The architecture is traditional central European, and there is German text printed in red at the top of the postcard.
